premises.text: Data control should be a fundamental human right, with equal data rights for all
premises.evidence_span: Data control should be a fundamental human right, with equal data rights for all.

premises.text: Users are unaware of the data they generate and who can see it
premises.evidence_span: the average user has no idea what data they're generating or who can see it

premises.text: Data harvesters earn significant revenue from user data
premises.evidence_span: Data harvesters like Facebook and Google earn nearly a trillion dollars a year.

premises.text: Ozone allows users to sync platforms to organize their personal data
premises.evidence_span: simply sync your platforms like Facebook and Google to see all of your personal data organized in simple categories

premises.text: Ozone offers a reverse subscription model for users to monetize their data
premises.evidence_span: Ozone offers a reverse subscription model, where companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data.

premises.text: Ozone's technology encrypts user data and only the user has the private key
premises.evidence_span: Our patented technology encrypts your data, and only you have the private key.

premises.text: Businesses can target audiences based on user data through Ozone
premises.evidence_span: Pick a zip code, age, gender, and category, and Ozone will return pre-approved audiences that match your targeted profile.

premises.text: Ozone provides tools for consumers to organize and secure their personal data
premises.evidence_span: we have a simple freemium model where consumers get simple, free tools to organize and secure their personal data

premises.text: Ozone has a patented technology that protects user data
premises.evidence_span: none have solved the privacy versus monetization paradox as we have... are missing our patented technology that protects user data forever.

value.text: Users can take back control of their data and monetize it
value.evidence_span: Take back control of your data, and take back the billions that big data is earning on you.

notes: No separate premises for user earnings and data syncing as they are part of the same value proposition.
